tools.name: get_city_stats
tools.description: Aggregate Thai-venue figures for one UK city/area, or up to five side by side. Use for totals and density, not for named venues. Returns venue count split by type, venues per 100k residents, and hygiene figures - a mean FHRS rating with the number rated, or FHIS pass/improvement counts for Scotland.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Lists named Thai venues in a city or area. Use when the user wants specific places rather than totals. Filters: business type, minimum FHRS rating (0-5, integers only). Returns name, address, postcode, rating, last inspection date and the total number of matches. Omitting city searches the whole UK

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Thai venues within a straight-line radius of a UK postcode. Use when the user gives a postcode or a place rather than a city name. Returns venues with great-circle distance in miles, rating and address; road distance will always be longer than the figure returned. No delivery, booking or opening-hou

tools.name: get_uk_overview
tools.description: UK-wide totals for Thai venues in FSA data: venue count with the dine-in, takeaway and pub-kitchen split, number of city/area rows, mean FHRS rating with the number rated, and the date of the snapshot. Single dated snapshot - there is no trend, growth or market-size figure.

tools.name: rank_cities
tools.description: Order city/area rows by Thai venue count, mean FHRS rating or venues per 100k residents. Use for 'which city has the most or the best'. tools.description: Food hygiene profile for Thai venues in a city, a local authority or a postcode district: the distribution of FHRS ratings 0-5 with mean and counts, or FHIS pass/improvement counts in Scotland, plus how old the inspections are. tools.name: get_opening_requirements
tools.description: Statutory steps for opening a food business in the UK, with the responsible local authority for a given city and official GOV.UK links. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_city_stats" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get detailed Thai restaurant statistics for any UK city. Returns restaurant count, hygiene rating, density per 100k population, dine-in vs takeaway breakdown, and market size classification." → after: "Aggregate Thai-venue figures for one UK city/area, or up to five side by side. Use for totals and density, not for named venues. Returns venue count split by type, venues per 100k residents, and hygiene figures - a mean FHRS rating with the number rated, or FHIS pass/improvement counts for Scotland."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
